cutoff.reason: No independent timestamp, log, commit, or hash record identifying the contamination cutoff was found in the inspected metadata-safe workspace scope. Filesystem chronology alone does not identify the contamination event and was not promoted to a cutoff.

observations.python_source_manifest_procedure: Sort src/**/*.py by absolute path; for each file emit workspace-relative forward-slash path, TAB, lowercase SHA-256; join rows with LF and one trailing LF; SHA-256 the UTF-8 bytes.

hold_release_condition: Provide or recover an independent audit record that fixes the contamination cutoff and a pre-cutoff clean governing hash/manifest against which the current source and candidate frozen development artifacts can be verified.
